Atomic supplied logo — verified typeface identity

Family: Inter
Style: SemiBold
Weight: 600
Matching font release: Inter 3.19 (font version 3.019)
Official source: https://github.com/rsms/inter/releases/tag/v3.19

Verification: the complete glyph segment structure and control points for both
atomic-logo-malo.svg (atomic) and atomic-logo-veliko.svg (Atomic) match the
Inter SemiBold font, after scale and translation, within the SVG coordinate
rounding tolerance. Maximum coordinate discrepancy is below 0.061 SVG units.
Both supplied light/dark variants retain these same letter shapes.

The SVGs contain outlined letters and do not require a font to render.
The original supplied artwork remains unchanged.

Previous website identity: lowercase atomic in Manrope, weight 600,
letter spacing -0.075em, beside the purple orbit symbol.

Decision: keep the current supplied Inter SemiBold wordmark. The lighter
comparison was a local study and has not been applied to the website.

Verification script: scripts/audit-logo-font.py
Detailed report: output/logo-font-audit/verified-font-identity.json

MONOCHROME: use the masters under monochrome/. The symbol must have four
separate shapes with transparent overlap gaps, matching the supplied black
reference. Black and white variants use identical geometry. Never flatten
the colour symbol into a solid silhouette. The wordmark remains unchanged.
